payload.question: The escalation suggestion is the 'this request is big: hold a short spec session first?' question the check raises on large or cross-cutting requests; your principle P6 says big requests are handled as one set approved in one step, and 'plumb spec show' is the view of that set. The 'triage' command (proposed records grouped by faithfulness; 8 uses ever, none from a skill) and the retired 'spec approve' are the only parts of spec and triage no workflow runs today; their inner functions are used by the judge and stay. Recommendation: keep escalation and 'spec show', remove the 'triage' and 'spec approve' commands.
